newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares leap to new record, Hansa active.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares leap to new record, Hansa active.

text.p: The bulls returned to the Estonian bourse on Monday with banking stocks taking it to new highs.
Total trade on the main list was a huge 196.7 million kroons as the Talse index gained 2.98 percent to end at a new record high of 430.53.
"It was a bullish market, though there was no big news to encourage the trade," one dealer said.
Dealers said that foreign investors may have been jittery in the wake of a fall in share prices across Europe and Wall Street.
But domestic buyers remained optmistic and kept up the buying pressure.
"We are seeing foreign investors selling and local investors buying, but we don't expect this to last for long," one trader said.
Hansapank was the most active stock with 102 million kroons traded to gain 0.50 kroons for a close of 219 kroons. It set a trading record for a single stock on the young bourse.
"Hansapank made some strong gains in morning trade with local buying interest keeping the stock higher," a trader said.
Both local and foreign buying interest in Uhispank took it to a record of 116.5 kroons, an increase of 11.1 kroons with 31.7 million kroons traded. The stock also gained 10 kroons last Friday.
"There are still no sellers in Uhispank, so the price just keeps on rising," a dealer said.
On the free market trade was low with only 1.9 million kroons traded as interest was firmly focused on the main list.
